name: let-me-polish-you-promo
description: Social launch video for Let Me Polish You (AIESEC in Poland), built with Remotion.

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts LaunchVertical output/let-me-polish-you-launch.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --pixel-format yuv420p --overwrite && node scripts/finalize.mjs output/let-me-polish-you-launch.mp4
scripts.render:nomusic: remotion render src/index.ts LaunchVerticalNoMusic output/let-me-polish-you-launch-no-music.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --pixel-format yuv420p --overwrite && node scripts/finalize.mjs output/let-me-polish-you-launch-no-music.mp4
scripts.render:network: remotion render src/index.ts NetworkVertical output/let-me-polish-you-network-launch.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --pixel-format yuv420p --overwrite && node scripts/finalize.mjs output/let-me-polish-you-network-launch.mp4
scripts.render:square: remotion render src/index.ts LaunchSquare output/let-me-polish-you-launch-1x1.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --pixel-format yuv420p --overwrite
scripts.render:landscape: remotion render src/index.ts LaunchLandscape output/let-me-polish-you-launch-16x9.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --pixel-format yuv420p --overwrite
